sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium concolor, plant_name_id 279952.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Its few flowers stand close at the stem's tip (Flora of China: 1-5 in a subumbel or raceme), drawn as a raceme a twenty-fifth of the stem long.

allometry.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stem 30-50(-80) cm; Wikipedia: usually 30-50 cm. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.4 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stem 30-50(-80) cm; Wikipedia: usually 30-50 cm.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves scattered, sessile.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves (2-)3-7(-10) cm x 2-10 mm; Wikipedia 3.5-7 cm x 3-6 mm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium concolor' (read 2026-10-18): leaves 3-6 mm wide; Flora of China 2-10 mm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves linear, apex acute; Wikipedia: linear to lance-shaped.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers 1-5 in a subumbel or raceme. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers erect; Wikipedia: they face upward.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals stellately spreading; Wikipedia: star-shaped.

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals stellately spreading.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals deep red; Bailey (p. 1877): bright crimson-scarlet. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): spotted or unspotted; Bailey: slightly, or not at all, dotted purple-black.

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium concolor, p. 1877 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): dotted purple-black. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals oblong-lanceolate to oblanceolate, 2.2-5.2 cm x 4-14 mm.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens converging; filaments 1.8-2 cm, anthers ca. 7 mm, within the spreading tepals.

traits.anther_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium concolor, p. 1877 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): anthers red. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsule oblong, (1.5-)3-3.5 x ca. 2.2 cm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsule ca. 2.2 cm wide.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering May-Jul.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium concolor (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): fruit Aug-Sep.
